actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong, FDR-significant pathway enrichment (coagulation, EMT up; metabolic/secretory down) and large effect sizes. WXS and CNV show only nominal trends, but the RNA signal is strong and coherent. Per-set technical confounders are not significant, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent biological identity supported by RNA (downregulation of immune pathways, upregulation of heme metabolism) and CNV (consistent lower copy-number on multiple arms), both with FDR significance. WXS shows only a nominal BAP1 depletion, but the RNA and CNV evidence is strong and coherent. Per-set technical confounders are not significant (q=0.065 trends are close but not FDR-significant). Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 is better supported than Drop.

C0003 lacks positive biological identity evidence: no RNA pathway, mutation, or CNV feature reached significance, and effect sizes are small. The set is strongly confounded by CT manufacturer and scanner model (FDR-significant per-set associations), providing a substantial alternative explanation for its identity, which is primarily CT-driven (CT median silhouette=0.276). The biological evidence is broadly absent, and the measured technical factors dominate the definition of this set. Dropping is better supported than retaining or structural correction.

C0004 lacks positive biological identity evidence: no RNA pathway, mutation, or CNV feature reached significance, and effect sizes are moderate but not FDR-significant. The set shows no significant technical confounders, but the absence of any coherent biological signal across modalities means there is no defensible identity to retain. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Dropping is better supported than accepting a candidate with no affirmative biological evidence.

C0005 has a coherent biological identity supported by RNA (strong upregulation of interferon and inflammatory pathways) and WXS (significant BAP1 mutation enrichment with large OR and narrow CI). CNV shows only nominal trends, but the RNA and WXS evidence is strong and coherent. The per-set technical association with tissue source site CJ is significant, but the biological identity is molecular (RNA and WXS) and not primarily imaging-driven, so the technical factor does not dominate the biological signal. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0005 is better supported than Drop.
